name: 西北农林科技大学
character: The main campus is divided into South and North campuses, featuring historic, rustic architecture like the 1934 No. 3 Teaching Building alongside newly built and renovated modern facilities.

landmarks.name: 北校区3号教学楼
landmarks.quote: 现北校区3号教学楼历史悠久，建筑风格古朴，系1934年建校时国民政府资助所建，兼有钟楼的功能
landmarks.look: Rustic historic teaching building with a clock tower and visible bomb scars.

landmarks.name: 绣山学生活动中心
landmarks.quote: 南、北校区各有1个“绣山学生活动中心”
landmarks.look: Modern student activity hall; the South Campus lobby contains a sculpture.

landmarks.name: 原昆虫博物馆
landmarks.quote: 位于北校区的原昆虫博物馆的建设亦得到了国家农业部的资助。
landmarks.look: Plain museum building on the North Campus.

landmarks.name: 南校区博览园建筑群
landmarks.look: Complex of exhibition buildings including an insect museum and animal museum.

landmarks.name: 西北农林科技大学图书馆
landmarks.quote: 西北农林科技大学图书馆的馆名由郭沫若书写。
landmarks.look: Library building featuring calligraphy signage by Guo Moruo.

landmarks.name: 北校区8号教学楼
landmarks.quote: 学校将主教学楼——八号教学楼进行了彻底的整修。
landmarks.look: Large, bright main teaching building with simple, fine modern decoration.
